A.hypothesis: Baseline. Fixed 500-char windows cut clauses mid-sentence; long evidence (>250 chars) is often split, lowering Evidence Hit@3.

B.hypothesis: Paragraph/khoản-aligned chunks keep each legal clause whole, raising Evidence Hit@3 and coherence vs A at the cost of fewer, longer chunks.

C.hypothesis: Same chunks as B; adding the user-supplied `part` filter only on questions that carry one removes look-alike clauses from other Parts (e.g. Art. 93 vs Art. 169), raising Hit@1 on filter questions and leaving other questions unchanged.

selection_rule: Decided before any test run: pick the strategy with the highest dev Evidence Hit@3; ties broken by dev Hit@1, then by dev filter-scope compliance, then by fewer chunks (cheaper index). Test is run once after the choice and is not used to change parameters.
